section_summary.extract_value: This section discusses the implications of the 'Be-Creative Effect,' focusing on methodological research concerning divergent thinking. It covers how to score responses (e.g., fluency, uniqueness, subjective ratings) and methods for administering tasks (e.g., time limits, atmosphere, prompt types). The text highlights that instructing people to 'be creative' robustly boosts creative responses across various tasks and samples, suggesting deeper methodological and mechanistic messages from this research.
